documentation.content: No verified database backup (BACKUP_OK) for 8 hours; the schedule runs every 6 h. Causes: BACKUP_ENABLED off, the scheduled workflow disabled by GitHub (60 days without repository activity), Workload Identity/secret access broken, or every run failing. RPO is growing. Runbook: vokr/docs/infrastructure/alerting.md and vokr/docs/infrastructure/backups.md
